payload.claim: This docstring says `anchored_blockers` and `anchored_concerns` both filter on the anchor, but after this diff `anchored_blockers` (saffron/phases/review.py:787-803) also keeps any blocker whose claim starts with `HOST_FILED`, anchored or not. The claim is now false for `anchored_blockers`; the task's own notes (SA-0299, 'Item 4, the prose') call out exactly this line for a rewording to 'filters on the anchor for a lens's finding', and that edit was never made even though every other listed docstring/comment update in the same list was.
